title: Dennis Kucinich laughed off a debate stage over UFOs

tellings.quote: There's a guy called Dennis Kucinich who was, you know, 2010 election I think. The moment his name became associated with UFOs, this was a former Democratic candidate for the presidency. In a debate stage he was pretty much laughed off stage and his candidacy plummeted, okay?

plain: The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels that when Dennis Kucinich, a Democrat who ran for president, got linked to UFOs, he was "pretty much laughed off stage" in a debate and his campaign "plummeted". Simosa tells it from memory, without a source, and is unsure of the date ("2010 election I think"). He offers it as proof of how much it can cost a politician to be tied to the subject.
